governing_statutory_rule: NBS publishes quarterly GDP ~55 days after quarter close (e.g. Q1 published late May; Q2 late August)
NBS publishes CPI bulletin on the 15th day of the subsequent calendar month
NBS publishes Food CPI alongside headline CPI on the 15th of each month
NBS publishes Core CPI alongside headline CPI on the 15th of each month
CBN publishes daily closing and weighted rates on business days
CBN publishes 30-day moving average gross reserves daily
CBN MPC meets bi-monthly (6 times per year) and announces policy rate changes immediately
NUPRC reconciles wellhead metering and publishes by mid-subsequent month
NUPRC publishes condensate data alongside crude oil monthly bulletin
NUPRC aggregates crude plus blended/unblended condensates monthly
DMO publishes complete quarterly debt bulletin ~75-90 days after quarter close
DMO domestic component breakdown published with quarterly bulletin
DMO external component breakdown published with quarterly bulletin
FAAC meets between 15th-20th of each month to allocate prior month statutory revenue
